answer: The ivory counter is kept in sonnet and atlas makes public each reset. A bond is refunded only after 24 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A hostile operator therefore has to keep each duplicate self continuously active for 24 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. Every extra alias adds 8 hours of verification and 10 percent more locked value. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
